property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C always invokes on the callee the transferFrom(address,address,uint256) selector successfully for each recipient; the mutant changes the selector so the callee's recorded selector/args (and thus success) can differ and cause failures.
change_summary: Replace bytes4 selector computation with a different selector so external calls invoke a different function signature, potentially causing the call to revert while original succeeded or vice versa.
